products.product_description: Queso Seco Centroamericano (Cheese) in individually soft poly/plastic bags labeled in part: Lacteos Santa Martha Queso Seco Centroamericano Dry White Cheese Net Wt 1LB (16oz)
products.reason_for_recall: Virginia State (VDACS) found Listeria monocytogenes in Lacteos Santa Martha Quesito Casero Fresh Curd; FDA made an inspection, were the environmental samples that came up positive also for Listeria monocytogenes, also the firm sent samples to a private lab that came positive for Listeria monocytogenes in various products. The firm is voluntarily recalling all their Lacteos Santa Martha products manufactured that are within expiration date.

products.product_description: Queso Seco Olanchano (Olanchano Style Cheese) in individually soft poly/plastic bags labeled in part: Lacteos Santa Martha Queso Seco Olanchano Dry Cheese Net Wt 1LB (16oz)
products.reason_for_recall: Virginia State (VDACS) found Listeria monocytogenes in Lacteos Santa Martha Quesito Casero Fresh Curd (Best by 9/27/14), FDA made an inspection, were the environmental samples collected came up positive also for Listeria monocytogenes, also the Oasis Brands Inc. sent finish products samples to a private lab, the Lacteos Santa Martha Cuajada en Hoja Queso Casero Hecho a Mano Fresh Curd (Best By dates of 10/18/14 and 11/25/14) came also positive for Listeria monocytogenes. Oasis Brands Inc. is voluntarily recalling ALL their Lacteos Santa Martha brand products manufactured that are within expiration date.
